recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. Only revisit if a new work-group decision asks to restore historical R3 comparison surfaces in the current build.
issue_request: FHIR-16505 was a Published/Persuasive STU3-era FHIR-core change request asking to fix the ElementDefinition page because it showed an "R2 Diff" tab but no "R3 Diff" tab.
initial_application: No commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-16505 was found. Related history shows the global diff page moved from R2 to R3 wording before the tracker was created, and later same-family FHIR-17721 records the datatype-page R2/R3 issue as already fixed by March 2019.
additional_context: ElementDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini and the current datatype/resource templates use "Version Diff" with R5, R4B, and R4 comparison artifacts. Later FHIR-39183 confirms that keeping an R3-specific label became wrong once R4 was the comparison baseline.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No current source edit is needed because adding or restoring an R3-specific tab would be stale for the current R6 build.

related_jiras.note: Later Published/Persuasive datatype-page issue described R2 Diff tabs where R3 Diff was expected and records "Already fixed".
Later Published/Persuasive R5 technical correction showed that an R3 Diff label on ElementDefinition had become stale and should be R4/current-baseline aware.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive STU3 change request noting that ElementDefinition had an R2 Diff tab but no R3 Diff tab.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the final seed request as a non-substantive historical page-generation correction.

evidence_items.summary: ElementDefinition is listed as an active type and maps to the elementdefinition page, whose source uses dtxheader for the generated datatype header.
evidence_items.learned: The ElementDefinition page is in current build scope and the checked source is authoritative for the audit.

evidence_items.summary: Current templates use a release-neutral Version Diff tab and point to R5, R4, and R4B diff artifacts.
evidence_items.learned: Current source does not retain the obsolete R2-only/R3-missing tab state and adding an R3-specific tab would be stale.

evidence_items.command: curl -fsSL https://build.fhir.org/elementdefinition.html | grep -Eo 'R[0-9A-Z]* Diff|Version Diff|Changes from R[0-9A-Z]+ to R6|Changes from R4B to R6'
evidence_items.summary: Rendered ElementDefinition has a Version Diff tab and generated R5/R4B/R4-to-R6 comparison sections.
evidence_items.learned: The built page already exposes the current version-diff surface without an R2-only tab.

evidence_items.summary: Git history changed diff wording from R2 to R3, then to R4, then to release-neutral/current multi-baseline diff links.
evidence_items.learned: The current template state reflects later baseline updates rather than an unaddressed FHIR-16505 defect.

evidence_items.summary: Brian Postlethwaite noted the ElementDefinition page had only an R2 diff tab, and Grahame Grieve asked for a task.
evidence_items.learned: The community thread corroborates the issue as a ballot-era generated-page defect rather than a current R6 source requirement.
